default/30609.htm.text: Astrologer Creta: Welcome, stranger... My name is Creta, I earn my living by fortune telling. In the past, even the Lords of the land came to us for tellings... But people often fear what they cannot understand and fortune telling has had an unfavorable light shone upon it by religious types. I can…

default/30609-1.htm.text: Astrologer Creta: My perceptions are shrouded in darkness. I see dark clouds in everyone's future, foretelling dark days ahead for the kingdom. We must all keep the faith.

Q00214_TrialOfTheScholar/30609-01.html.text: Astrologer Creta: Greetings. I have been waiting for you. Maria sent you, correct? By your expression, it must be. The stars are never wrong. We have no time to waste, please give me Maria's Letter.

Q00214_TrialOfTheScholar/30609-06.html.text: Astrologer Creta: I am not getting anywhere without any clues . Go to Maria and ask her for any object that is related to the incident.
when: state STARTED; has items 2675,2689,2683; lacks items 2680

Q00214_TrialOfTheScholar/30609-07.html.text: Astrologer Creta: Ah, a handbag left by Maria's friend! Very interesting... Handbags are very important to most women. Only a very careless woman would leave such an object behind. This is certainly a sign of a future incident.
when: state STARTED; has items 2675,2689,2682; lacks items 2680,2683

Q00214_TrialOfTheScholar/30609-10.html.text: Astrologer Creta: This drawing will be a great help to you. You will surely be able to find the thief and retrieve Maria's scroll. Believe in yourself.

Q00214_TrialOfTheScholar/30609-11.html.text: Astrologer Creta: I am very happy to help people find precious items that have been misplaced. Have you found that which you seek?

Q00214_TrialOfTheScholar/30609-12.html.text: Astrologer Creta: As I foretold you have come to me again. I see from your face that you are somewhat uncomfortable with your situation. What can I do for you?

Q00214_TrialOfTheScholar/30609-15.html.text: Astrologer Creta: These days I am very happy to help people who have misplaced precious items.

Q00214_TrialOfTheScholar/30609-02.html.text: Astrologer Creta: How is my old friend Maria? She seems to have nothing to live for since she stopped making the Crystal of Purity. This skill requires extensive knowledge of the coldness of the moon, and the waxing and waning of a star. I would like to help her in any way I can. You came to me see…

Q00214_TrialOfTheScholar/30609-03.html.text: Astrologer Creta: I need more clues before I can determine the identity of the thief of the scroll. I only have a vague idea of who may have the scroll now. A clue that can be evidence is essential, do you understand?

Q00214_TrialOfTheScholar/30609-04.html.text: Astrologer Creta: My divination skills seem to be failing me lately, dark clouds cover the future of all I see. There are surely dark days ahead for the Kingdom. We must keep the faith. I sense that you are in the midst of an important test, perhaps one that will benefit Maria? I also sense that yo…

Q00214_TrialOfTheScholar/30609-05.html.text: Astrologer Creta: The clue I need is an item from the place where the incident happened. It could be anything, I only know that it is related to the incident. Bring one clue for me. Speak with Maria , she can answer questions about any object associated with the incident.

Q00214_TrialOfTheScholar/30609-08.html.text: Astrologer Creta: Please be still, I am feeling something.... ... I see a shadow... A long, dark shadow that hugs the ground... Now the shadow stands on it's two legs... The arms and head are not human, and there is a tail! Hard to explain in words... This is my feeling...

Q00214_TrialOfTheScholar/30609-09.html.text: Astrologer Creta: A very good idea, I shall do my best.... Let's see, the arms were unusually long, and the head much larger than a human's. And the tail... It seemed as though the shadow was cast by one far away.. Oh yes, one more thing before you go. . Soon you shall meet an ancient one. This mee…

Q00214_TrialOfTheScholar/30609-13.html.text: Astrologer Creta: Another robbery, eh? 20 years ago? There was a recent robbery that I could see quite clearly, but one so far in the past, I cannot be sure. Let me attempt to see...

links.text: Ask whether she has found the clue

Q00214_TrialOfTheScholar/30609-14.html.text: Astrologer Creta: I can see that you are still in a hurry. I have told you all that I have seen. There were many shadows, this means many culprits. I definitely recognize the shadow of a human. There are differences between shadows, but I see no more shadows of monsters. Take this letter explaining…
